name: enterprise-page
title: Enterprise page
description: The site's enterprise page from library items: the header, the hero inside its ring of creatives, the logo row, the automation run under its quote, the eight features and the close with two buttons, then the footer.

import { AutomationRun } from '@/components/site/AutomationRun' import { EnterpriseFeatures } from '@/components/site/EnterpriseFeatures' import { EnterpriseHero } from '@/components/site/EnterpriseHero' import { PageClose } from '@/components/site/PageClose' import { ProofStrip, proofPlaceholders, type ProofLogo } from '@/components/site/ProofStrip' import { SiteHeader } from '@/components/site/SiteHeader' import { AsciiTrail } from '@/components/visuals/AsciiTrail' import { SiteFooter } from '@/components/blocks/SiteFooter' import type { RunItem } from '@/lib/automation-run' import type { RingCard } from '@/lib/enterprise-ring' import type { EnterpriseFeaturesContent } from '@/lib/enterprise-features' import { enterprisePageContent, type EnterprisePageContent, enterpriseSections, type EnterpriseSection } from '@/lib/pages/enterprise' import { cn } from '@/lib/cn' import { pageSections } from '@/lib/image' import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react' import type { HeaderMenus } from '@/lib/site-header' // The site's enterprise page (app/enterprise, pages/Enterprise/EnterprisePage), from library items in the site's order: // the header, the hero inside its ring of creatives, the logo row (24px under the hero, 16 from 768, the section's // padding below), the automation run under its quote, the eight features, and the close with two buttons and no drifts, // then the footer. `content` replaces the copy; `cards`, `logos`, `run` and `features` take your creatives and marks // (Acme placeholders by default). export interface EnterprisePageProps { content?: EnterprisePageContent cards?: RingCard[][] logos?: ProofLogo[] run?: RunItem[] features?: EnterpriseFeaturesContent /** The header menus' content, pictures included (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`); Acme by default. */ menus?: HeaderMenus /** The sections to show, in order; all of them in the page order by default (leave one out to omit it). */ sections?: readonly EnterpriseSection[] className?: string } const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-[calc(var(--ds-layout-content)+2*var(--ds-layout-gutter))] px-(--ds-layout-gutter)' export function EnterprisePage({ content: c = enterprisePageContent, cards, logos = proofPlaceholders, run, features, menus, sections, className }: EnterprisePageProps) { const parts: Record = { hero: , proof: (
), run: , features: , close: , } return (
{pageSections(enterpriseSections, sections).map((k) => {parts[k]})}
) } export default EnterprisePage
